name: Georgetown University
type: Catholic university; private university; private not-for-profit educational institution; research university
text: Georgetown University is a private Jesuit research university in Washington, D.C., United States. Founded by Bishop John Carroll in 1789, it is the oldest Catholic institution of higher education in the United States, the oldest university in Washington, D.C., and the nation's first federally chartered university. The university has eleven undergraduate and graduate schools.

depictions.name: Georgetown
depictions.text: Georgetown is a Washington, D.C. neighborhood located in the northern part of the city. While it is only accessible via the metro system, there are numerous metro stations connected to it.
